name: zn15_52_lot_savvy_cell_altitude
description: Test 46 (ZG22): GetLotSavvyCellAltitude(cx, cz, ok) always writes *ok when ok is non-null. A lot with flag bit 0 at (10, 10), altitude 12.5, gives 12.5 and ok = true. A lot at (12, 12) whose flags have bit 0 clear, altitude 99, does not: the terrain path runs at (r24(r24(cx + 0.5) * 16), r24(r24(cz + 0.5) * 16)) and ok = false, so a lot without flag bit 0 is not 'on a lot'. A cell with no lot (20, 30) takes the terrain path (world (328, 488)) with ok = false. There is no bounds check: (-5, -5) takes the same path, its terrain look-up at (-72, -72) finding nothing, and ok is still written as false. Slots 17 and 18 write *ok the same way; the earlier reading that left *ok untouched is superseded.
